> RETRORGB                              
  PS2 Slim: M.2 SATA Mod Revealed       
                                        
  The new M2 Slim mod adds M.2 SATA     
  storage to SCPH-700XX consoles. It    
  restores direct IDE bus connectivity  
  to slimline units, enabling seamless  
  OPL game loading without the typical  
  USB 1.1 stutter.                      
                                        
  Source: RetroRGB (Wed, 11 Nov 2026)
